asset.name: Button
asset.description: The primary action control: a labelled, token-bound button that acknowledges activation immediately, expresses intent through semantic variants, and keeps stable dimensions while it moves through pending, success, and failure.

requires.reason: Owns the unified pointer, touch, keyboard, and focus-visible interaction model so Button does not reimplement activation.

suggests.reason: Buttons frequently lead with an icon, but a text-only button is complete on its own and should not drag the icon registry into a closure that does not need it.
Icon-dense toolbars pair buttons with tooltips, though a labelled button needs no supplementary description.

signatureMoment.description: Pressing a button that starts real work acknowledges on the same frame and holds its exact width through pending, success, and settle, so a row of buttons never shifts while one is working.

rationale: The single most-adopted asset in any library, and the one whose defects propagate furthest. The current implementation fails tap-target-size at mobile, sets border-radius twice across conflicting size and shape maps, and duplicates its class-merging helper into every other component file — all defects that this entry's required capabilities would surface.
